meta.note: Demo dataset. Every row is invented; none of it is the owner's.

mp_brief.style_brief: An invented brief: plain old furniture in honest materials, scaled to a small house.
mp_brief.reject_brief: Anything shiny, flat-packed or painted to look old.

travel_bands.use_for: Rare pieces, or a planned day.

rules.rule: A trip costs 45p a mile all in. Worth it when the fair price less what is paid beats that.
rules.why: A small saving far away is a loss.

rules.rule: Until contracts exchange, buy only small things.
Above fair, open at the good price. At or under good, pay the asking price and go.
No deposits and no moving off the platform. Pay on the doorstep after looking.
rules.why: There is no buyer protection on a collection.
